protocol: Same physical parent and centered additive six-branch Schur attention, all parameters train. Only diagonal3Hz versus Hermitian known-HC force differs. Full-corpus force followed by chunked bank VJP and full parameter pullback. Six fixed N36 attempted steps, no best-iterate or energy-based backtracking. Every step evaluates max alpha and fourteen fixed bisection trials per arm. Match physical FS distances to the target within2.5%, require arm ratio<=1.05. If either direction cannot match or violates the parent cap, reject BOTH updates; retain the attempt and optimizer moments. No hidden extra directions or step extension.
metric: Same fixed positive development Gram for both arms: fresh128 calibration records plus ALL256 previously viewed force-audit records at this size. Each set's Gram is normalized by its empirical carrier norm before a half-half mixture. This is a measured development metric, NOT untouched data or a certified physical distance. No previously viewed sample enters training energy or terminal audit. Preserve constituent-set diagnostics and audit/metric transfer. Never discard rare points or add them without their original Q weights.
audit: Generate new16 chains only after both fixed endpoints and all derived inputs are hash-sealed. Shared carrier HC comes from the Q bridge. Evaluate reference and each changed endpoint full H once; unchanged banks reuse exact saved actions. Node-safe fullH moments include carrier nodes and H-only contributions. Pair entire chains. No surrogate variance or independent-snapshot errors.
release: N64 prepare/train/audit forbidden unless N36 preregistered gate entirely passes. CV-parent energy upper95<0 and CV-diagonal energy mean<=0; variance delta+oneJKSE<=10%parent is operational safety, not variance-win/noninferiority proof. Audit/metric FS²<=2, between-arm FS ratio<=1.25, norm-weight ESS>=.1, ray-residual and H-residual max chain<=.6. Require all attempted steps genuinely matched/accepted. N64 only2 steps with new seeds and fresh metric/audit; no production release.8x8 misses K. Failure closes this run; no extra audit or relaxed threshold.
cost: Common train samples, steps, full-gradient calls and fixed scalar-search callback count. Actual CPU time and compilation reported separately per arm, not forced identical; no GPU-hours claim. N36 audit up to384 residual-H centers plus128 cheap carrier-H; N64 up to192 plus64. No new ED, architecture, carrier family or sampler. Checkpoints preserve parameters, Adam moments, corpus identity and cumulative stage wall budget.
